base_protocol.arrival_model: independent Poisson arrivals per second; common tape across budgets
base_protocol.dispatch: global synchronous frames; released jobs only; FIFO within class
base_protocol.score: queue weighted actual frame departures divided by actual frame duration
base_protocol.budget_unit: candidate construction or feasibility attempt; seeds included
base_protocol.stopping_rule: stop arrivals at horizon, then drain the same finite prefix

eligibility: S(a) >= max(S_seed, (1-r)*S_inc); S_inc is the same paid pool's best support
cap_rationale: 1% is a fixed conservative design choice, not a fitted or optimal parameter
zero_cap_control: preserves paid incumbent support while allowing holding-cost changes among ties
arrival_rate_input: Lambda=sum(registered class arrival rates); fixed throughout arrival window and drain
drain_cost_interpretation: stationary-arrival proxy, not actual conditional arrivals after the cutoff
candidate_generation: same budgeted construction, order and max-support pruning as frozen v4
reference: frozen v4 K120; both cap policies retain their own selected support gap
prior_seed_only_comparison: reuse the previous 36 seed-only runs; do not rerun or overwrite them
stopping_rule: run all 108 cases once; no cap relaxation, grid search or budget selection after results
